name: web-vertical-ruler-of-dashes-with-timestamp-tooltip-card
title: Vertical ruler of grey dashes where nearby dashes grow long and black, pointing to a white timestamp note '01:50' with a bold line
whatItIs: A white page with a vertical column of short horizontal dashes; those near the centre extend and turn black like a magnified wave, and a white rounded card with a soft shadow at their right shows '01:50', a bold line 'honor prefers-reduced-motion' and a grey explanation.
whatItMeans: Precise and delightful; a magnifying-dock effect makes a scrub bar feel tactile.
techniques: Scale nearby ticks in a wave.

vocabulary.definition: A column of small marks used as an index.
Nearby items growing like a dock effect.
A card labelled with a time.
An accessibility setting that limits animation.
